code:
Alarm:      northfield-glue-etl-failure
Metric:     glue.driver.aggregate.numFailedTasks
Dimensions: JobName=northfield-orders-etl
Threshold:  >= 1, over 300s
Action:     SNS northfield-pipeline-notifications
caption: Watches Glue's own metrics — independent of Step Functions.

code:
Alarm:      northfield-stepfunctions-failure-alarm
Metric:     ExecutionsFailed  (AWS/States)
Dimensions: StateMachineArn=...:northfield-pipeline-orchestrator
Threshold:  >= 1, over 300s
Action:     SNS northfield-pipeline-notifications
caption: Catches infra-level failures the state machine's own Catch might miss.

subtitle: Scoping every role to exactly what it needs.
